attributes.has_name: Select and integrate an ASIL B-capable perception processor
attributes.task_description: Select a commercially available microprocessor suitable for an ASIL B perception function and integrate it according to its safety manual. Confirm that the selected device and system concept provide the required diagnostics, including processor execution monitoring, watchdog and clock supervision, ECC or parity for relevant memories, memory and logic self-tests, protected configuration, fault reporting, and a defined safe reaction. Document the assumed diagnostic coverage and any external safety mechanisms required by the processor safety manual.

Define protected communication from the camera, LiDAR, and infrared sensor to the perception compute unit. The interface shall provide end-to-end data integrity and communication supervision appropriate to the channel, including CRC, sequence counters, freshness or timeout monitoring, source/channel identification, and detection of missing, repeated, stale, corrupted, or wrongly assigned data. Define the reaction when a channel fails the communication checks.
